papers.title: Posterior Matching Distillation
papers.author: Hidir Yesiltepe
papers.summary: Diffusion distillation accelerates image and video generation by compressing a pretrained teacher's iterative sampling process into a few network evaluations. Distribution-based methods achieve this by matching the student's output distribution to the teacher's. This matching is often driven by reverse-KL objectives, whose mode-seeking bias favors dominant teacher modes at the expense of diversity across samples. We introduce Posterior Matching Distillation (PMD), a new member of the distribution-based distillation family that combines mode-covering posterior sampling with any-step generation. At zero population loss, PMD recovers the teacher's full posterior of clean images at each trained noise level. Its stochastic student supports any-step sampling budgets within the trained timestep grid without further training. To learn these posteriors, PMD matches exponentially reweighted averages of student samples conditioned on a fixed noisy state to corresponding teacher posterior means. Under Gaussian corruption, exponentially tilted posterior mean is a single teacher evaluation at a shifted input. We prove that, matching tilted means over an open neighborhood uniquely identifies the full posterior. PMD thus supervises the entire conditional distribution through a family of mean constraints, without any auxiliary student-score network. Experiments on SDXL and FLUX.2 [klein] 4B demonstrate that PMD achieves the best FID among 4-step methods on both models, while maintaining competitive or leading performance across prompt-alignment and perceptual-quality metrics.
papers.translated_summary: 扩散蒸馏通过将预训练教师的迭代采样过程压缩为少量网络评估来加速图像和视频生成。基于分布的方法通过使学生输出分布与教师分布相匹配来实现这一点。这种匹配通常由反向KL目标驱动，其模式寻求偏差偏向于主导的教师模式，而牺牲了样本间的多样性。我们引入后验匹配蒸馏（Posterior Matching Distillation, PMD），这是基于分布的蒸馏家族的新成员，它将模式覆盖的后验采样与任意步数生成相结合。在零种群损失下，PMD在每个训练的噪声水平上恢复教师干净图像的完整后验。其随机学生支持在训练时间步网格内的任意步数采样预算，无需进一步训练。为了学习这些后验，PMD将以固定噪声状态为条件的学生样本的指数重加权平均值与相应的教师后验均值相匹配。在高斯损坏下，指数倾斜后验均值是在偏移输入处的单次教师评估。我们证明，在开邻域上匹配倾斜均值唯一地识别出完整后验。因此，PMD通过一族均值约束来监督整个条件分布，而无需任何辅助学生分数网络。在SDXL和FLUX.2 [klein] 4B上的实验表明，PMD在两个模型上均取得了4步方法中最佳的FID，同时在提示对齐和感知质量指标上保持有竞争力或领先的性能。

papers.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
papers.translated_title: 扩散Transformer中的强化学习后训练是激活引导
papers.author: Tuna Han Salih Meral
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.
papers.translated_summary: 强化学习（RL）后训练显著提升了扩散变换器的视觉质量、文本渲染和组合准确性。由于渲染指定文本或组合多个物体等能力本质上依赖于提示词，一个自然的假设是：改进这些能力需要学习复杂的、依赖输入的变换。为了分离出其中有多少收益可由一个与输入无关的偏移来解释，我们用一种刻意简单的参数化方式来探查每个经RL调优的模型：在冻结基座模型各模块输出上加上一组固定的引导向量。在SD3.5-M上，这些向量的参数量比经RL调优的LoRA少65倍（0.29M对18.8M）。我们拟合这些向量以匹配公开的经RL调优检查点的速度预测，目标函数中不含奖励。尽管这些向量对每个提示词、token和采样种子都完全相同，它们仍恢复了六个经RL调优图像模型90.0–96.3%的奖励增益，并在两个经RL调优视频模型上分别恢复了89.8%和111.9%。以零初始化并用在线RL训练，这些向量本身在SD3.5-M的文本渲染（OCR）和人类偏好（PickScore）上超过了基于权重的RL的奖励增益。因此，一个恒定偏移足以解释策略梯度RL后训练的大部分增益：无需新的依赖输入的变换，它就能将预训练生成器引导向它本已能够计算的内容。

papers.title: AnyVIO: Feed-Forward Streaming Visual-Inertial Odometry Across Platforms
papers.translated_title: AnyVIO：跨平台的前馈流式视觉惯性里程计
papers.author: Omoruyi Atekha
papers.summary: Geometric foundation models (GFMs) estimate camera mo- tion and scene structure from images without requiring ex- pert parameter tuning, but either lack metric scale or rely on learned priors to infer scale, which is unobservable from monocular images alone. Inertial sensing offers a way to observe metric scale, but existing methods add inertial in- formation through a filter or factor graph, which reintro- duces bespoke parameter tuning and optimization costs that can grow with the trajectory. To bridge this gap, we present AnyVIO, a real-time, feed-forward streaming model for monocular visual-inertial odometry (VIO), which combines a streaming GFM with an inertial foundation model (IFM). Both the GFM and IFM predict the metric motion between consecutive frames, and a lightweight learned fusion head quantifies the reliability of each estimate and blends them in a single forward pass. Across nine datasets recorded from cars, legged and ground robots, and handheld and head- mounted devices, AnyVIO reduces the metric position error of its visual model by 36% while publishing each pose esti- mate 70 ms after an image is received. We further deploy AnyVIO onboard two real vehicles at up to 140 km/h, where it remains accurate in poor lighting and heavy dust.
papers.translated_summary: 几何基础模型（GFMs）无需专家参数调优即可从图像中估计相机运动和场景结构，但要么缺乏度量尺度，要么依赖学习到的先验来推断尺度，而尺度仅凭单目图像是无法观测的。惯性传感提供了一种观测度量尺度的途径，但现有方法通过滤波器或因子图引入惯性信息，这重新引入了定制参数调优和优化成本，且这些成本会随轨迹增长而增加。为弥合这一差距，我们提出AnyVIO，一种用于单目视觉惯性里程计（VIO）的实时前馈流式模型，它将流式GFM与惯性基础模型（IFM）相结合。GFM和IFM均预测连续帧之间的度量运动，一个轻量级学习融合头量化每个估计的可靠性，并在单次前向传播中将二者融合。在涵盖汽车、腿足与地面机器人、手持及头戴设备录制的九个数据集上，AnyVIO将其视觉模型的度量位置误差降低了36%，同时在收到图像后70毫秒内发布每个位姿估计。我们进一步在兩辆真实车辆上以最高140公里/小时的速度部署AnyVIO，其在弱光和浓尘环境中仍保持准确。

papers.title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
papers.translated_title: PlayCraft：从智能体游戏体验设计引人入胜的游戏
papers.author: Weihao Cheng
papers.summary: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its detailed play experience to revise them for mastery. Starting from an initial game, PlayCraft alternates between playing and crafting. In the playing stage, a player agent watches the game screen, uses the controls, and pursues the game objective over repeated episodes while retaining memory. After each episode, it reports its progress, outcomes, decisions, and reflections. In the crafting stage, a crafter agent uses these reports to revise the game. It estimates player abilities, predicts performance at different proficiency levels, and compares those predictions with a target learning progression. It diagnoses the game and addresses the gaps by giving players meaningful opportunities to improve through better decisions and execution. We evaluate games in fresh runs with player agents across three intelligence settings, measuring learning gain and learning slope. Compared with the initial games, PlayCraft yields larger learning gains and steeper learning slopes in most games. It also outperforms the baselines on the macro-average of each metric at every intelligence setting.
papers.translated_summary: 近期的人工智能体能够生成可玩的游戏，但这些游戏未必具有吸引力。精通是吸引力的关键来源，然而为其进行设计需要大量的人工游玩和调优。我们提出PlayCraft，一个自动化框架，它使用基于视觉的智能体来游玩游戏，并利用其详细的游玩经验来修订游戏以实现精通。从初始游戏开始，PlayCraft在游玩和制作之间交替进行。在游玩阶段，玩家智能体观察游戏画面，使用控制操作，并在保留记忆的情况下于多个回合中追求游戏目标。每个回合结束后，它报告其进度、结果、决策和反思。在制作阶段，制作者智能体利用这些报告来修订游戏。它估计玩家能力，预测不同熟练度水平下的表现，并将这些预测与目标学习进程进行比较。它诊断游戏并通过为玩家提供有意义的机会来改善决策和执行，从而解决差距。我们在三种智能设置下使用玩家智能体在全新运行中评估游戏，测量学习增益和学习斜率。与初始游戏相比，PlayCraft在大多数游戏中产生更大的学习增益和更陡的学习斜率。在每个智能设置下，它在每个指标的宏平均上也优于基线。

papers.title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
papers.translated_title: TideCache：具有透明缓存管理和逐层流式传输的高效混合LLM服务
papers.author: Jinbin Luo
papers.summary: Hybrid architectures have become mainstream among open-weight language models. Their global-attention and bounded-state layers maintain heterogeneous caches whose demands vary with context length and concurrency. We present TideCache, a serving system on CPU--GPU superchips with three components for allocating GPU memory among caches and managing their residency across GPU and host memory. The Transparent Cache Pool redistributes physical pages among cache components behind fixed virtual addresses, preserving cache layouts and backend interfaces. The Cache Streamer uses computation intervals provided by bounded-state layers to prefetch the next global-attention layer's prefix into GPU slots shared across global-attention layers, reducing GPU residency while overlapping layer-wise transfers with computation. Generated KV remains resident. The Request Scheduler selects resident or streamed execution and triggers capacity adjustments according to request size and queue state. Together, they let HBM released by streaming accommodate other cache components and additional requests. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on GB300 and GH200 across seven model/platform configurations, TideCache completes up to 2.04x as many agent turns, reduces overall P50 per-token latency by 20--59%, and improves agent P50 TTFT by 1.40--3.05x compared with SGLang with HiCache.
papers.translated_summary: 混合架构已成为开放权重语言模型中的主流。其全局注意力层和有界状态层维护着异构缓存，这些缓存的需求随上下文长度和并发度而变化。我们提出TideCache，一个运行在CPU-GPU超级芯片上的服务系统，包含三个组件，用于在缓存之间分配GPU内存并管理其在GPU与主机内存之间的驻留。透明缓存池在固定虚拟地址背后重新分配缓存组件之间的物理页，保持缓存布局和后端接口不变。缓存流式器利用有界状态层提供的计算间隔，将下一个全局注意力层的前缀预取到跨全局注意力层共享的GPU槽中，在减少GPU驻留的同时将逐层传输与计算重叠。生成的KV保持驻留。请求调度器根据请求大小和队列状态选择驻留或流式执行，并触发容量调整。三者共同使流式释放的HBM能够容纳其他缓存组件和额外请求。在SGLang中实现，并在GB300和GH200上跨七种模型/平台配置进行评估，与使用HiCache的SGLang相比，TideCache完成的智能体轮次最高可达2.04倍，将整体P50每token延迟降低20%至59%，并将智能体P50 TTFT提升1.40至3.05倍。

papers.title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
papers.translated_title: 一个先验，两种动态：将视频扩散Transformer重新用于自监督潜在动作学习
papers.author: Yuxin Jiang
papers.summary: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics. We introduce O$^{2}$LaF, built on a simple principle: one prior, two dynamics. We initialize both models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapt them to their distinct roles: a feed-forward transition encoder with learnable action queries for inverse dynamics, and a causal, action-conditioned video generator for forward dynamics. By controlling information access and optimizing both dynamics end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, O$^{2}$LaF learns transferable actions from unlabeled videos. Across navigation and robotic manipulation, O$^{2}$LaF sets a new state of the art in few-shot action probing and enables stronger zero-shot action transfer across visual contexts and embodiments. Beyond generative video priors, we further extend our framework to predictive representation priors such as V-JEPA2, achieving competitive performance. Our findings suggest a broader paradigm for latent-action learning: repurposing pretrained video models to discover transferable actions and predict their consequences.
papers.translated_summary: 视频揭示了世界如何变化，但很少揭示导致这些变化的行为。潜在动作学习从视觉过渡中恢复此类监督，但通常几乎从头学习底层动力学。我们探究预训练视频生成器能否转而同时为逆向和正向动力学提供先验。我们提出O$^{2}$LaF，基于一个简单原则：一个先验，两种动力学。我们从相同的预训练视频DiT初始化两个模型，并使它们适应各自不同的角色：一个带有可学习动作查询的前馈过渡编码器用于逆向动力学，以及一个因果的、以动作为条件的视频生成器用于正向动力学。通过控制信息访问并通过紧凑瓶颈端到端优化两种动力学，O$^{2}$LaF从无标注视频中学习可迁移的动作。在导航和机器人操作中，O$^{2}$LaF在少样本动作探测上创造了新的最先进水平，并实现了跨视觉上下文和具身形态的更强零样本动作迁移。超越生成式视频先验，我们进一步将框架扩展到预测性表示先验，如V-JEPA2，取得了有竞争力的性能。我们的发现暗示了一种更广泛的潜在动作学习范式：重新利用预训练视频模型来发现可迁移的动作并预测其后果。

papers.title: ScaleWorld: High-Resolution World Generation through Shared Prediction and Refinement
papers.translated_title: ScaleWorld：通过共享预测与细化实现高分辨率世界生成
papers.author: Yansong Qu
papers.summary: High-resolution generation enables video world models to render fine-grained scene structures and textures, but directly generating high-resolution video incurs substantial computational and memory costs. We present ScaleWorld, a causal video model that unifies low-resolution world prediction and high-resolution refinement within a single shared backbone. By refining its own predictions, ScaleWorld produces high-resolution world videos without requiring a separate refinement model. For each video chunk, the shared backbone first completes a low-resolution prediction and then performs one-step high-resolution refinement conditioned on that prediction. To support efficient streaming generation, we maintain separate causal states with a long low-resolution history for prediction and a short high-resolution history for refinement. To address task interference during distillation, we separate specialist optimization from capability consolidation and introduce task-asymmetric on-policy distillation (TA-OPD). This procedure transfers prediction and refinement behaviors from specialized teachers into a shared student through local velocity matching under their respective sampling and history policies. {Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScaleWorld achieves high-quality world generation with improved computational and memory efficiency.
papers.translated_summary: 高分辨率生成使视频世界模型能够渲染精细的场景结构和纹理，但直接生成高分辨率视频会带来大量的计算和内存开销。我们提出ScaleWorld，一种因果视频模型，在单一共享主干网络内统一了低分辨率世界预测与高分辨率细化。通过细化自身的预测，ScaleWorld无需单独的细化模型即可生成高分辨率世界视频。对于每个视频块，共享主干网络首先完成低分辨率预测，然后在该预测的条件下执行一步高分辨率细化。为支持高效的流式生成，我们维护独立的因果状态，其中用于预测的长低分辨率历史和用于细化的短高分辨率历史。为解决蒸馏过程中的任务干扰，我们将专家优化与能力整合分离，并引入任务非对称在线策略蒸馏（TA-OPD）。该过程通过在各自采样与历史策略下的局部速度匹配，将预测和细化行为从专家教师迁移到共享学生模型中。大量实验表明，ScaleWorld在提高计算和内存效率的同时实现了高质量的世界生成。

papers.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
papers.translated_title: AgentRoboCritic：理解前沿智能体在直接机器人控制中的能力
papers.author: Yiyang Du
papers.summary: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.
papers.translated_summary: 前沿多模态语言智能体（如 GPT-6 Astra）已展现出强大的能力，能够通过低层数值动作直接控制机器人，而无需高层原语。然而，现有基准仅报告回合级成功率，既无法说明这些智能体如何成功，也无法说明它们在何处失败。本文针对 12 个操作基准上的直接机器人控制，对前沿智能体进行了系统的动作级分析。我们提出了 AgentRoboCritic，一个基于意图的评判框架，其中策略智能体在给出每个动作的同时声明一个局部意图，评判器则针对该意图评估动作的结果与失败模式。我们的动作级分析展示了前沿智能体在直接机器人控制上的可观能力，包括对局部执行失败的闭环恢复、跨多样场景的可靠语义 grounding，以及无需任务特定适配的强零样本操作能力。分析也识别出它们当前的局限，包括与任务相关的物理执行瓶颈（如抓取与对齐），以及不同失败模式下恢复能力不均衡。最后，我们在一个包含 400 个动作的人工标注基准上验证了评判器，并发布了包含 12,844 个标注动作的数据集以及一个微调的开源评判器 Muse-Glimmer-30B，其失败模式准确率从 32.58% 提升至 74.24%，从而支持低成本的动作级分析。

papers.title: Bio-PM-Guided Synthetic IMU Generation
papers.author: Deepali Singh
papers.summary: Collecting and labeling inertial measurement unit (IMU) data for human activity recognition (HAR) is expensive, and models trained on one group of subjects often fail to generalize to unseen individuals. Even with balanced data, classifiers struggle to distinguish dynamically similar activity classes and benefit from targeted augmentation. We explore whether synthetic IMU data generated in the representation space of a pretrained biosignal encoder, Bio-PM \cite{b1}, can serve as a practical augmentation source. Rather than synthesizing raw signals, we leverage Bio-PM's frozen encoder to convert 10-second IMU windows into token embedding sequences and train class-conditional decoders in this space: (1) an autoregressive transformer decoder that predicts tokens sequentially, and (2) a diffusion decoder that learns the token distribution through a denoising objective. We analyze generation realism through distributional metrics and embedding-space visualizations, evaluate downstream utility through leave-one-subject-out HAR classification, and present a PatchDecoder for approximate raw waveform reconstruction. Our diffusion decoder achieves a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) macro-F1 of 0.68, demonstrating that generated tokens are realistic enough to train a classifier that transfers to real data. Combining synthetic-token augmentation with a 320-dimensional gravity-aware feature representation raises LOSO macro-F1 from 0.729 to 0.809 over a real-only baseline across 51 subjects on the WISDM benchmark, with statistically significant gains concentrated in the most challenging activity classes. These results demonstrate that high-fidelity generation in a pretrained encoder's representation space is achievable and practically useful for cross-subject HAR augmentation.
papers.translated_summary: 为人类活动识别（HAR）收集和标注惯性测量单元（IMU）数据成本高昂，且在一组受试者上训练的模型往往难以泛化到未见过的个体。即使数据均衡，分类器也难以区分动态相似的活动类别，并受益于有针对性的增强。我们探索在预训练生物信号编码器 Bio-PM \cite{b1} 的表示空间中生成的合成 IMU 数据能否作为实用的增强来源。我们不合成原始信号，而是利用 Bio-PM 的冻结编码器将 10 秒 IMU 窗口转换为 token 嵌入序列，并在该空间中训练类别条件解码器：（1）自回归 transformer 解码器，逐序预测 token；（2）扩散解码器，通过去噪目标学习 token 分布。我们通过分布度量和嵌入空间可视化分析生成的真实性，通过留一受试者交叉验证的 HAR 分类评估下游效用，并提出一种 PatchDecoder 用于近似原始波形重建。我们的扩散解码器在合成数据训练-真实数据测试（TSTR）上达到 0.68 的宏 F1，表明生成的 token 足够真实，可训练出能迁移到真实数据的分类器。将合成 token 增强与 320 维重力感知特征表示相结合，在 WISDM 基准的 51 名受试者上，将 LOSO 宏 F1 从仅真实数据基线的 0.729 提升至 0.809，统计显著的增益集中在最具挑战性的活动类别上。这些结果表明，在预训练编码器的表示空间中实现高保真生成是可行的，并且对跨受试者 HAR 增强具有实际效用。

papers.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
papers.translated_title: Depth Pro 2：清晰且时间一致的度量单目深度
papers.author: Peiyun Hu
papers.summary: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. We release code and weights at https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-depth-pro-2/
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出 Depth Pro 2，一种在全分辨率下为图像和视频估计稠密度量深度的方法。通过分析以往的单目深度估计方法，我们发现它们通常会在时间一致性和边界锐度之间进行权衡：多帧方法倾向于一致性，单帧方法倾向于锐度。为克服这一权衡，我们训练了一个单一且可扩展的网络，该网络同时处理图像和视频，并在原生分辨率下预测深度图。Depth Pro 2 生成的深度图同时具备度量准确、锐利和时间一致的特点，在这三个方面均优于以往工作。我们发布了一系列模型，在度量精度、锐度、时间一致性和运行时间方面定义了新的帕累托前沿。代码和权重发布于 https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-depth-pro-2/
